div.p: Quality refers to how good something is compared to other similar things. In other words, its degree of excellence. When used to describe people, it refers to a distinctive characteristic or attribute that they possess.

Efficiency is a key principle throughout every stage of engagement with our clients. Our team are highly-trained to deliver fast, effective service from first contact, during the sales experience, and right through to after-sales and beyond.

TAYA is made up of innovators who specialise in developing new and cutting-edge solutions that truly meet the needs of the market. We take sustainable growth seriously, and always have our sights set on the future.

TAYA believes that trust is the foundation of all relationships, and this is a value that we carry with us at all times when conducting business, both within the company and with our customers worldwide.

TAYA is a pioneer in flexible composite textiles, with over 50 years of expertise in delivering world-class fabrics across diverse industries and applications worldwide. Our name has long been synonymous with quality, reliability, and innovation.

Recognising the urgent need for sustainable alternatives, TAYA took a bold step more than a decade ago to develop KAVALAN, our groundbreaking range of PVC-free coated banner materials. What began with large-format printing media for the signage and advertising sector has since expanded into industrial applications, as we continue to push boundaries and pave the way toward a greener future.

All our products are produced in accordance with international standards and regulations such as ISO9001, ISO14001, REACH, RoHs, 6P and DIN4102-B1, and these cover a range of technology areas including fireproof, waterproof, anti-static, and lacquering. TAYA is the reliable and innovative global leader in technical textiles, offering flexible solutions that are guaranteed to meet your needs.

div.div: TAYA is an agile, versatile business that isn’t afraid to challenge the status quo. We are always adapting and evolving, continuously looking for ways to innovate and exceed the expectations of our customers. Partnering with TAYA means working with a company that views the world through your lens, and is focused on moving your operations forward.

img.div: TAYA Groups is committed to protecting the rights and welfare of its employees, and creating a safe working environment for our staff. We are dedicated to providing a safe place for our staff, free from pollution and hazards.

TAYA Groups has been advocating for the concept of sustainability, and actively strengthening its corporate sustainability governance. We have developed an internal CSR framework that echoes the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) set out by the United Nations.

TAYA is a self-proclaimed pioneer of the green revolution, and the expectation that through the construction of an inclusive culture, scientific innovation, support for public and social initiatives, and environmental sustainability.
